_comment: Showcase demo seed (#107). Operator-editable: titles, descriptions and links. The first entry is Venture Route by Njuguna Njenga, the Operator and the one real person in this file ("operator": true): his profile carries his name and this entry only, with no cohort, certification, skill chips or profile links, because the seed invents no facts about a real person (AGENTS.md rule 10). The other builders and their entries are fictional. Every row is demo data. Schema placeholders, not claims: every seed profile gets location "Schema placeholder", day rate 1 and remote mode because the store requires them; they are never shown on the Showcase and never routed (seed builders have no availability). Entry order is gallery order. Links must be https:// (no localhost or IP literals); pitchVideoUrl is a YouTube link or null. Builder ids start with demo- and never change once seeded. Skills come from the nine-skill vocabulary and never include mobile. Removing an entry does not delete its rows. Run: uv run python scripts/seed_showcase_demo.py

entries.title: Venture Route
entries.description: Turns a founder's venture brief into a staffing route: the verified builders, partner and cohort fit, reusable IP and the gaps, each with the reasoning path MeTTa matched. Built for the Basix ecosystem.

entries.title: Crop price SMS digest
entries.description: A daily SMS digest of market prices for maize, beans and tomatoes across county markets, so smallholder farmers know where to sell before they travel.

entries.title: School fees tracker
entries.description: Parents see what they owe and what they paid per term; bursars reconcile mobile money receipts against a class list in one screen. Licensable to school networks.
